title: Facebook Ads is a volume game
description: Facebook Ads is a volume game
transcript: Meta ads is often now a volume game. The advertisers that can produce the most high quality ad creative win. Because each new ad creative you produce is another chance at finding something that can really land, that can allow your campaigns to scale, that can massively improve your return on ad spend. So the lesson here is to produce more ads, but you want to do so intelligently. Instead of creating lots of full ads, particularly talk about video ads, you want to create a relatively limited number of full ads, but lots of different hooks. Hooks. The first three seconds, that's the part that fatigues, that's the part that grabs people's attention. Or not. By far the most important. And by simply recording a full ad and then creating, say, 10 different hooks for it, different visual hooks in different locations, different verbal hooks. By saying different lines, you can get much more out of the ads you're already creating.
